# Data Factory

> Open-source AI data team for Claude Code: AI agents for data engineering, analytics, data science and BI, plus a quality inspector agent that verifies every number with hidden checks. One data person sets intent and approves; the agents build. MIT licensed.

- Repository: https://github.com/nimrodfisher/data-factory
- Install: `/plugin install data-factory --marketplace nimrodfisher/data-factory`
- Commands: /data-factory:init, /data-factory:run, /data-factory:spec, /data-factory:inspect, /data-factory:status, /data-factory:learn
- Agents: data-engineer, data-analyst, data-scientist, bi-engineer, quality-inspector
- Works with: Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, Postgres, DuckDB, dbt, SQLMesh, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Superset, Lightdash, Hex, Streamlit
- Not related to Azure Data Factory (Microsoft's ETL service).
